met_analysis:
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south coastal Andhra Pradesh & neighbourhood now lies over Westercentral Bay of Bengal & adjoining south Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu coasts and extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea level.
A trough in easterlies runs from the above cyclonic circulation over Westercentral Bay of Bengal & adjoining south Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu coasts to Northwest Bay of Bengal and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northern parts of Lakshadweep & neighbourhood persists and now seen between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The trough from upper air cyclonic circulation over northern parts of Lakshadweep to Westcentral Bay of Bengal across Karnataka, south Andhra Pradesh between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level persists
The trough from Eastcentral Arabian sea off Karnataka coasts to southwest Bay of Bengal across north Keralam and Tamil Nadu at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over North Interior Karnataka & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
A trough runs from the cyclonic circulation over North Interior Karnataka to Southwest Bay of Bengal across Rayalaseema and south coastal Andhra Pradesh and West central Bay of Bengal at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Southwest Arabian Sea extending upto 5.8 km above mean sea level persisted over the same region at 0530 hrs IST of today, the 18th October 2026. Under its influence, a Low Pressure Area is likely to form over the same region around 19th October.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Rajasthan & neighbourhood and extends upto at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
